TRACE Stage 4 production-hardening verification record.

Pump P-9901 is located in Area Z9. P-9901 feeds TK-9902. SOP-9903 describes the maintenance of P-9901. The required verification marker is TRACE-E2E-20261002-P9901.

If bearing overheating is observed on P-9901, stop the pump, isolate electrical power, verify zero energy, inspect lubrication, and follow SOP-9903 before restart.
